(“Cipher” or the “Company”), a leading owner, developer and operator of industrial-scale data centers, today announces a 10-year high-performance computing (HPC) colocation agreement with Fluidstack, a premier AI cloud platform that builds and operates HPC clusters for some of the world’s largest companies. Under the agreement, Cipher will deliver an additional 39 MW of critical IT load, supported by a maximum of 56 MW of additional gross capacity, at its Barber Lake site in Colorado City, Texas. With these newly contracted megawatts, Fluidstack will increase the size of its original transaction and will lease the entire 300 MW of capacity at Cipher’s Barber Lake site. The agreement represents approximately $830 million in contracted revenue over the initial 10-year term and includes two five-year extension options.
